description:
## Scope

Workspace canonical-template propagation. The 'Re-registration semantics' rustdoc block and the reworded 'Pass the same Arc<B>' line now live in:

- bd:JMAP-jfia.4 — original `Dispatcher::register` doc + `try_register` precedent
- jmap-mail-server (canonical extension-server) — re-registration block added pre-existing, Arc reword landed in bd:JMAP-ayoz.26
- jmap-metadata-server — both landed in bd:JMAP-ayoz.26

Six extension-server siblings still lack the workspace canonical text and need the propagation:

1. jmap-chat-server (`register_chat_handlers`)
2. jmap-calendars-server (`register_calendars_handlers`)
3. jmap-tasks-server (`register_tasks_handlers`)
4. jmap-contacts-server (`register_contacts_handlers`)
5. jmap-filenode-server (`register_filenode_handlers`)
6. jmap-sharing-server (`register_sharing_handlers`)

## Two changes per crate

### (A) Reword the misleading 'Pass the same Arc<B>' phrase

Current text (paraphrased — exact wording varies slightly per crate):

> Pass the same Arc<B> to both this function and any application-level code that needs the backend directly.

This implies a single `Arc` identity matters when it does not (Arc::clone semantics — separate Arc<B> instances pointing at the same backend work fine). Replace with the canonical wording landed in jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs and jmap-metadata-server/src/lib.rs:

> You may pass any Arc<B> — the function clones it internally into each registered handler closure. Sharing the same Arc<B> across this call and other application-level uses of the backend is a memory optimization, not a correctness requirement; separate Arc<B> instances pointing at the same underlying backend would also work.

### (B) Add the '# Re-registration semantics' rustdoc block

Mirror the canonical paragraph from jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs lines ~130-148 / jmap-metadata-server/src/lib.rs lines ~83-104. The exact text per crate substitutes the spec citation (e.g. 'draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-XX method name' instead of 'RFC 8621 method name') and the method-name example in the 'Custom overrides go LAST' bullet (e.g. 'Calendar/get' instead of 'Metadata/get').

The closing line about concurrent calls is identical across crates:

> Concurrent calls to this function on the same dispatcher are forbidden at the type-system level by the &mut Dispatcher argument; the borrow checker rejects them at compile time.

## Acceptance

- All 6 sibling `register_*_handlers` functions carry both (A) the reworded Arc line and (B) the '# Re-registration semantics' rustdoc block
- `cargo doc -D warnings` green on each affected crate
- No code change — pure doc edits
- Workspace test suite still green
- Bead can be split into 6 children if desired, or landed as a single commit

## Why P3 not P2

API-contract clarity, no behavior change. The bead .26 that drove this was P2 because it surfaced a real foot-gun (callers writing defensive code against undocumented semantics); the 5-7 propagation work is mechanical and the foot-gun risk is already mitigated by the canonical mail-server having the paragraph.

## Cross-references

- Driving bead: bd:JMAP-ayoz.26 (closed)
- Foundation precedent: bd:JMAP-jfia.4 (Dispatcher::register vs try_register)
- Workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' (mail-server is canonical, this is propagation)
title: Propagate register_*_handlers re-registration semantics doc + Arc reword to 6 extension-server siblings
